integrations.title: Integrations

onec.title: 1С:Предприятие — exchange
onec.subtitle: Two-way CommerceML sync (УТ / УНФ / Розница)
onec.enableHint: Once on, 1C is allowed to sync with this store.
onec.loginHint: The login 1C authenticates with (you choose it). Enter the same value in 1C.
onec.passwordHint: The password 1C authenticates with. Leave blank to keep the current one.
onec.urlHint: Paste this into the 1C exchange node (Обмен с сайтом). Cloud 1C needs a public URL (ngrok / production).
onec.statsLine: Last import: {{cats}} categories · {{created}} products created · {{updated}} updated · {{offers}} offers (price/stock).
onec.how1: In 1C (УТ / УНФ): Обмен с сайтом / Синхронизация → add a node.
onec.how2: Paste the Exchange URL above + the login & password.
onec.how3: Click «Проверить соединение», then run the exchange — catalog imports, orders export.

connector.primaryHttp: {{label}} must start with http:// or https://
connector.saveFirstThenTest: Save the integration first, then test
connector.confirmDelete: Delete this integration? Logs are preserved.
connector.signingHint: Verify <0>X-Torta-Signature: sha256=<hex></0> on every request: <1>HMAC-SHA256(body, secret)</1>.
connector.subscribeAllHintMailchimp: Mailchimp listens to customer.created only — other events are silently skipped server-side.
connector.subscribeAllHintGa4: GA4 maps order.paid → purchase, order.created → begin_checkout. Other events are skipped.
connector.subscribeAllHintDefault: When ON, every event from this project triggers this integration.

request.comingSoonSub: Tell us you want it — we email you the day it ships and prioritise the most-requested ones.
request.notePlaceholder: What's your use case? Which fields matter most?
request.thanksBody: Your request has been logged. We'll email you when {{name}} goes live.

accounting.fileExportNote: Nothing to “connect” — {{name}} has no live API, so this is a file export. Click Download for the CSV now, or set a Schedule below to email it automatically. You (or {{name}}) then import that file — steps are at the bottom.
accounting.pickBothDates: Pick both start and end dates for a custom range.
accounting.showingOf: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} orders. Download for the full file.
accounting.noMatchingOrders: No matching orders in this period.
accounting.cadenceHint: When set, we email a signed download link on your cadence — file bytes themselves stay on the CRM and the link is valid for 30 days.
accounting.recipientHint: Required only when the schedule is on. Leave blank for download-only.
accounting.activeHint: Disabled integrations stop receiving scheduled exports until re-enabled.
accounting.setEmailOrOff: Set a recipient email or switch the schedule to Off.
accounting.confirmDelete: Delete this accounting integration? Past downloads aren't affected.
